annotations.title: Rank pitches against an investment thesis

description: Rank pitches by fit (fit_score 0-100, with the criteria matched) against a thesis: thesis_text, or the investor's saved thesis (use_saved_thesis). A rule-based match on sector, stage, region and keywords, not a judgement; the thesis text is never logged or stored. Needs an API key. Each pitch returned counts 1 against the shared daily pitch allowance (0 if this caller already got it today).

limit.description: Results, capped at the caller's tier ceiling.

thesis_text.description: The thesis in plain English. Not with use_saved_thesis.

use_saved_thesis.description: Use the thesis saved on the key owner's profile. Not with thesis_text.

name: pitchspark_thesis_fit_v1

pitchspark_score.description: PitchSpark's AI pitch score, 0 to 100, at any value; null when the pitch has not been scored.

thesis.description: The structured thesis that was matched: sectors, stages, regions, keywords, source.

title: Rank pitches against an investment thesis
